title: Options: Reducing Risk for Others
text: Believe it or not, if you're selling options, a lot of times, what you're doing is reducing the risk for somebody else. You are taking a risk premium for them. So, let's talk about what this looks like. For a lot of traders, you go through the aggressive growth cycle, and that is ultimately what you focus on for probably the majority of your trading career, rightfully so. There is a position where that hits an apex, and it flips. And you're not so concerned with top-line returns anymore, but you become a little bit more concerned with how can I reduce my drawdown, my volatility.
